state.paragraph: Between July 11, 2013 and July 23, 2013, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona engaged in a preliminary review of Mac-Gray and the potential acquisition opportunity. Also during this time, outside counsel to Party A and representatives of Goodwin Procter negotiated the terms of a confidentiality and standstill agreement, but did not come to agreement on the terms of the customer and employee non-solicitation provisions.
state.target_sentence: Also during this time, outside counsel to Party A and representatives of Goodwin Procter negotiated the terms of a confidentiality and standstill agreement, but did not come to agreement on the terms of the customer and employee non-solicitation provisions.

criteria.row_16: 06/30/2013 | Party C | NDA signed | Confidentiality and standstill agreement; received the informational package.
criteria.row_17: 07/06/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Other material event | Refuses rollover partnership: denies the request (relayed by Rothenberg 07/03) for Moab to partner exclusively with CSC/Pamplona on a rollover. Such talks allowed only later.
criteria.row_18: 07/11/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | NDA signed | Agreement with Pamplona Capital Management LLC, reused in the merger agreement (s. 6.17). Received the informational package. Party A's NDA talks stalled on non-solicit terms 07/11-07/23.
criteria.row_19: 07/23/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Bid | price 18.5 | Preliminary IOI based only on the informational package, with no data room or management access (Heavy by context).
criteria.row_21: 07/23/2013 | 16 other financial NDA signers | Did not submit | Inferred. 20 signers − Party A (no NDA until 08/05) − 3 submitters = 16. On 07/25 the target named only four interested bidders. Some may have signed after 07/23.
criteria.row_22: 07/24/2013 | Party B | Bid | price 17-18 | Written preliminary IOI, one day after the due date. Based on the informational package only (Heavy by context).
criteria.row_23: 07/24/2013 | Party C | Bid | price 15-17 | Oral preliminary IOI to BofA, one day after the due date. Based on the informational package only (Heavy by context).
criteria.row_24: 07/25/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Round opened | Committee finds IOIs lower than expected. Advances four: Party A (subject to NDA), Party B, Party C, CSC/Pamplona. Staged disclosure; management meetings for all, synergy information for strategics; revised IOIs to follow.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
